findings.title: Container connects to a fixed IP, not the Service's address
findings.cause: container api exits because its connection to 10.96.0.201 fails: the address is written into DB_HOST=10.96.0.201, and Service db, which DB_HOST names, has cluster IP 10.96.19.163, not 10.96.0.201; a Service gets a new cluster IP when it is created again, and its name stays; its log says: "wget: download timed out"; Deployment api has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container api exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container api's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail:
connecting to the database at 10.96.0.201:5432
Connecting to 10.96.0.201:5432 (10.96.0.201:5432)
wget: download timed out

evidence.command: kubectl get service db -n kd-service-ip-hardcoded -o jsonpath='{.spec.clusterIP}'

findings.fix: Set DB_HOST to the Service's name, db (or db.kd-service-ip-hardcoded.svc), which cluster DNS keeps pointing at its current address, in place of 10.96.0.201.
